description: This file contains functions for checking and validating database settings during the installation or configuration of the SuiteCRM application. It includes procedures for validating user inputs, testing database connections, and managing session variables related to database configuration.

methods.name: checkDBSettings
methods.description: Validates the database settings provided by the user or configuration, tests database connectivity, and checks for errors or conflicts before proceeding with installation.

methods.name: printErrors
methods.description: Outputs the errors encountered during database validation, either as a success message if no errors are found or as a detailed list of issues.

methods.name: copyInputsIntoSession
methods.description: Copies user input data from request parameters into session variables and manages logic for creating or using existing database users during setup.
